name: JST XH socket, 2 pin, side entry (JST S2B-XH-A)
summary: White 2-pin battery and sensor socket lying on its side on a board. The plug needs an 8 x 6.4 mm slot.
source: JST XH catalogue (eXH): the S2B-XH-A side-entry header is 7.4 mm wide with posts at 2.5 mm pitch, stands about 6.1 mm tall and runs 9.2 mm back from its mouth. The mating XHP-2 housing is 7.3 x 5.7 mm, which the 8.0 x 6.4 mm slot clears. The common top-entry B2B-XH-A has the same 7.4 mm width and stands 7.0 mm tall, 9.8 mm with the plug in.

keepouts.label: Room for the plug and wires

electrical.note: Rated 3 A with AWG 22 wire, 250 V.
